analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: S&P 500 decisively lost its 50-day moving average with no outright oversold signals. The September low above 7,500 held and the index closed well off intraday lows, so the candle hints at a possible reversal that needs confirmation.
VIX had a huge candle on Friday that rejected the mid-20s and the June high. VIX is not overbought and remains in an uptrend, which keeps volatility elevated.

Nasdaq 100 broke key horizontal support and printed its lowest close in three months. The 200-day moving average held and the index closed well off intraday lows. Immediate supports are 28,093 and 27,927.

SOX was aggressively rejected at its 50-day moving average and prior uptrend line last week. Friday broke the 200-day moving average but bounced off the July low. 10,440 is the critical support and there is scope to reclaim the 200-day.
Semis have broken their long-term uptrend versus the S&P 500. Similar breaks have historically preceded broader market corrections by roughly six months.
Semi equipment (S5SEEQ) pulled back Friday but did not revisit the prior weeks' lows, which hints at relative resilience. A looming death cross and broadly negative structure keep risks skewed lower.

Brent crude reversed sharply from flagged resistance and unwound overbought conditions. Given its negative correlation to semis, EFG sees this move as arguably more equity-positive than the price action in equities themselves.

EFG sees macro and technical parallels between 2026 and 2018: midterms, a new Fed chair, Trump's second year and bearish divergences from semis and transports. In 2018 the S&P bounced twice before the December washout.

Swiss Market Index is forming an evening-star-type pattern after strong gains, with the close key for confirmation. It is overbought but holding above 14,670 support, so it may prove more pause than reversal.
KOSPI printed a bullish engulfing candle on 2 November and avoided retesting recent lows, a positive divergence versus Friday's US weakness. A looming death cross keeps the setup fragile.

Japan TOPIX slipped away from the 3,990 pivot and is approaching its 200-day moving average. RSI remains above oversold, which suggests further downside potential, with the 200-day as the next key support.
